title: 皐月賞の後に・鬼、炸裂

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The intense race is over, and Winning Ticket, having been unable to achieve victory, shows her frustration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On top of that, she is worried about the mounting threat of Narita Taishin and her fierce sprinting ability.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Shaking off her uneasiness, Ticket forces herself to focus squarely on the Japanese Derby, where she can't afford to lose.
